purpose: Non-graphic wording reference for controller-resolved scene summaries; not an executable action registry.

sceneTemplates.event: The participants share an accepted embrace.
The adult participants share a mutually welcomed flirtatious moment.
The adult participants share a private, consensual intimate encounter.

rules: Use only facts established by the gameplay controller; templates are not evidence that an event occurred.
Preserve authored tone; do not infer tone from player instructions or arousal values.
A posture, body region or broad verb alone establishes neither a specific act nor fluid exchange.
Duration, willingness, acceptance, fluid route and resistance outcomes require separately resolved records.
Do not combine labels into explicit sexual instructions or direct a narrative model to reconstruct omitted acts.
This reference adds no parser routes, NPC permissions, transmission triggers or automatic outcomes.
Fluid names and contact-record field definitions are reference vocabulary only; they add no infectiousness, exposure thresholds, barriers or resistance rules.
Drooling alone establishes no recipient contact. Consuming drool requires a resolved ingestion event; brief contact or a single swallow does not automatically satisfy a timed threshold.

contactRecordFields.source: Controller-resolved source participant or sample identifier.
contactRecordFields.fluidType: Recorded fluid name; terminology alone establishes no exposure.
contactRecordFields.freshness: Recorded sample age or live-source status under existing rules.
contactRecordFields.contactRoute: Actual route established by the contact controller.
contactRecordFields.contactDuration: Actual qualifying contact duration in game minutes.
contactRecordFields.barrierPresent: Recorded clothing or barrier status; does not independently decide protection.
contactRecordFields.contactEndedAt: Game-clock timestamp when actual contact ended.
